title: Gorenstein property along compositions of morphisms of algebraic spaces, with descent along flat morphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For morphisms of algebraic spaces with locally Noetherian fibres, the four statements say that the Gorenstein property composes and descends along flat morphisms, pointwise and globally. The retained proof first reduces etale locally to the scheme case and then gives an explicit ring route: using the stated equivalence between the Gorenstein property and a condition on strict local rings, it exhibits the concrete local homomorphism of the quotient rings, identifies its fibre, and applies the flat-under-Gorenstein lemma of dualizing complexes. The exhibited homomorphism and the identification of its fibre are the written reduction steps. Retained author proof at lines 6630-6651.
